description: Extracts structured content from BuzzFeed articles, including checklist items (TV shows, movies, etc.), quiz results, and article metadata from buzzfeed.com.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_article: Fetch article metadata (title, author, publish date, tags); 参数: url; 必填: url
  - get_checklist: Extract checklist items from quiz/checklist articles (TV shows, movies, etc.); 参数: url, include_metadata; 必填: url
  - get_quiz_results: Extract quiz result options from personality quizzes; 参数: url, include_metadata; 必填: url

url.description: The BuzzFeed article URL. Required for all functions. Example: https://www.buzzfeed.com/hattiesoykan/how-many-of-imdbs-top-100-rated-tv-shows-have-you-seen

include_metadata.description: Whether to include article metadata in the response. Used by get_checklist and get_quiz_results. Default: true.
